_note: Player races (character creation). Stats adapted from the MUD's race sheets (max natural stats minus 3); perks are this game's own. effect: hp_pct, damage_pct, spell_pct, skill_bonus, stats (boon stats, see boons.json), charges (extra per-run Skip/Reroll/Banish).

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.desc: Tough and stubborn. Resists bashing blows.

high_elf.name: High Elf
high_elf.desc: Quick and gifted with magic. Resists dark magic.
high_elf.perk: Fleet of foot: +5 dodge, +10% spell damage.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.desc: Small, nimble and hard to pin down.
halfling.perk: Hard to hit: +15 dodge, but -10% max HP.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.desc: Huge and brutal. Immune to poison, resists slashes, weak to piercing.

lizardman.name: Lizardman
lizardman.perk: Tail lash: hits have an 8% chance to stagger (freeze for a turn).

daemon.name: Daemon
daemon.desc: Cruel and cunning. Immune to dark magic, resists piercing.
daemon.perk: Bloodthirsty: every kill heals 5% max HP.

golem.name: Golem
golem.desc: A living statue. Resists piercing, weak to lightning.
golem.perk: Made of stone: take 2 less damage from every hit.
